entries.test: Public examples available by August 16, 2023, of LLM-generated false or low-quality material degrading online content would test whether this process was already underway.
entries.note: The surrounding examples give the otherwise evaluative term a concrete factual reading.
The comparison depends on Marcus's personal expectations, whose extent is not established by his published warning.

entries.test: Amazon listings, book contents, and documented production methods could establish whether GPT-generated books with substantive quality defects were being sold by the publication date.
entries.note: “Flooding” adds a stronger claim about volume than the passage establishes.

entries.test: Contemporaneous Amazon listings and their contents could establish whether rapidly published histories of recent events contained factual inaccuracies.
entries.note: “Beginning to fill up” strengthens “starting to be a receptacle.” The factual core is checkable, although “exploitative” is evaluative.

entries.test: Archived Bard and ChatGPT outputs, source citations, and publication chronology could establish whether Bard reproduced an error originating in ChatGPT.
entries.note: Matching errors alone would not establish the asserted copying.

entries.test: Documented LLM outputs and expert assessment of the advice could establish whether LLMs generated materially harmful or seriously erroneous advice.
entries.note: The supplied text calls the recipe “disconcerting,” without establishing the more specific characterization “dangerous.” This is an assertion of demonstrated capability, not an uncertain possibility.

entries.test: Publicly documented provenance showing a fabrication generated by one LLM subsequently reproduced by another through ingestion or retrieval would demonstrate the predicted circulation.
entries.note: “Once they do make stuff up” supplies an explicit antecedent; no deadline is given.
“May ultimately” asserts a possibility. Marcus explicitly reaffirms his own earlier passage.
The compound claim includes only a possibility of Google's demise. The conditional prediction about search value is expressed more firmly.
He explicitly quotes song lyrics and adopts them as a rhetorical flourish. The normalization turns that flourish into an explicit growth forecast.
